cornerCallouts: Into Turn 1, the NGK Chicane, they go! A crucial braking zone and a potential overtaking spot on the opening lap.
The Dunlop hairpin is next, a very tight corner that can catch drivers out if they're too aggressive on the throttle.
Through the Kumho curve, a tricky right-hander that requires precision and commitment. Get it wrong, and you're off into the gravel.
The Ford Kurve is a long sweeping right-hander. The drivers will be trying to carry as much speed as possible through there.
Now they're heading towards Turn 9, a fast left-hander that requires a delicate balance of speed and control.
Negotiating the Mercedes Arena complex now. A series of tight corners that demand precision and car control.
The drivers are pushing hard through the Yokohama S, a fast and flowing section that separates the good from the great.
Coming onto the start/finish straight now after negotiating the final corner, a sweeping right-hander. Time for them to reset for another lap.
strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a major factor on this STT layout. Managing the tires through the long corners will be key to a successful race.
The pit window here is relatively short, meaning teams will need to be precise with their stops. Every second counts!
Fuel consumption will be a concern, especially in the early stages of the race. Teams will be monitoring their fuel levels closely.
With the relatively short lap time of the STT layout, traffic management will be crucial. A well-timed pit stop can gain you valuable positions.
The abrasive surface of the Nürburgring will put the tires through their paces. Expect to see varying strategies based on tire wear.
The balance between downforce and straight-line speed is crucial here. Teams will be experimenting with different aero setups to find the optimal compromise.
The weather can change quickly in the Eifel mountains, so teams need to be prepared for any eventuality. A well-timed switch to wet tires could be a race-winning decision.
The short lap length means there will be constant pressure from behind. Drivers will need to be aggressive in defending their positions.
